corrections.text: The article states that JetBrains' blog post 'summarizes the release in six bullet points spanning the standard library, Kotlin/Native, Kotlin/Wasm, Kotlin/JS, Gradle and the Build Tools API.' The JetBrains blog post (blog.jetbrains.com/kotlin/2026/09/kotlin-2-4-20-released/) actually lists seven bullet categories: Standard library, Kotlin/Native, Kotlin/Wasm, Kotlin/JS, Gradle, Build tools API, and Kotlin compiler. The article's enumeration omitted the 'Kotlin compiler' bullet (covering the kotlinr runner rename and the experimental native compiler image).
